scope.purpose: Choose one value from a list of known options in a form, shown collapsed in a field.
useCases: A country, a language or a time zone among a known list (5 to about 25 options).
A sort order or a category in a filter bar.
Options grouped under headings (records with a group).
exclusions: Searching or typing in the list (Combobox).
Free content in options (icons, descriptions) in v1: options are records with value, label, disabled and group.
alternatives: Combobox for a long list or a searched one.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the leading icon example.

examples.preview: dist/previews/select.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview select)

contract.scope: Select compound contract: bindable value and open, options records (value, label, disabled, group), placeholder, label, size, disabled, readonly, invalid, required; InputText-like trigger on color.input.*; children panel, option, group; WAI-ARIA select-only combobox keyboard; panel capped by size.overlay.list.

decisionsTaken: The trigger is an InputText look-alike: same color.input.* roles, sizes, spacing and focus indicator; the chevron and the check mark are intrinsic Phosphor glyphs (caret-down, check) copied into the folder.
Options are records (value, label, disabled, group), per the records decision of 2026-10-31; consecutive records with the same group are gathered under a heading (child group).
One compound contract with children panel, option and group (decision of 2026-10-31); the panel is a child so that its surface roles do not collide with the trigger's.

Option rows reuse the Menu item geometry (32 px minimum, padding sm, radius.container in a radius.overlay panel); only the text follows the Select's size (typography.body.{size}), so that an lg select does not list small text.
Selected option: color.item.selected surface plus a check mark in color.item.indicator at the inline end, so that selection is not conveyed by color alone.

Keyboard per the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern: focus stays on the trigger, the highlighted option is the active descendant; no wrapping (like a native select); Page Up and Page Down; typeahead; disabled options reached but not chosen (as in Menu).
Tab closes the list without choosing (the pattern allows choosing on Tab; not choosing avoids accidental changes when tabbing through a form).

Panel: at least the trigger's width, up to max(trigger, size.overlay.panel); block size capped by the new role size.overlay.list (256 px, about 7.5 options visible so that the cut row signals the scroll) and by the viewport room.
The value never changes while the list is closed (arrow keys open it), unlike some native selects.

Gate question 1 resolved (user, 2026-11-09: "ok pour tes 5 recommandations"): the shift along the viewport edge is fixed in lib/overlay for every overlay (Popover, Menu, Tooltip, Select, Combobox), with a browser test per overlay near the edge, presented at the implementation gate.
Gate question 2 resolved (user, 2026-11-09): size.overlay.list = 256 px for Select and Combobox; Menu unchanged (viewport room only), to revisit at the visual pass (roadmap 4b).

Bits UI Select is not used: its content assumes its own portal and focus scope, and it unmounts when closed (no exit transition); as for Menu (decision of 2026-10-31), the component is written on the native auto popover with lib/overlay. Recorded for the implementation gate.
The trigger is a button with the combobox role (WAI-ARIA select-only combobox): it keeps focus; the highlighted option is aria-activedescendant; presses in the panel never take focus.
Options API: records (`options` prop) as the contract says; groups from consecutive records with the same group.
nextAction: Wave 4 implementation gate pending: the user reviews the preview pages, then the approval is recorded.
implementationNotes: Exports Select and the SelectOptionsRecord type.
The trigger toggles the panel through popovertarget (exempt from light dismiss); keys open it through the open state.
`name` submits the value through a hidden input.
A press on the Field label activates the trigger, as for any button, and opens the list.

informational.reason: Same trigger colors as InputText (color.input.*): its exemption accepted at the wave 2 contract gate (2026-10-26, "4 ok") applies; color.input.default.border reaches 2.06 on surface.muted in dark, a de-emphasized backdrop where forms are not expected.
